meta.label: Colts at Chiefs
meta.series: Colts lead the all-time series 18-11 across 29 meetings (5 postseason). Mahomes is 1-2 as a starter against Indianapolis.

sources.name: Sharp Football Analysis - Week 2 matchups, team tendencies and unit outlooks
Sharp Football Analysis - Colts vs. Chiefs Week 2 worksheet (Rich Hribar)
Arrowhead Pride - Chiefs-Colts Week 2 final injury report

weather.forecast: Thunderstorms in the area through the evening
weather.note: High 77 / low 66 with storms moving through Sunday. A wet ball and 9-19 mph wind is a real, if modest, thumb on the scale toward the run and the short game. Not a wind game that kills the deep ball outright.

rest.note: Monday night into Sunday night is a six-day turnaround. Kansas City ranks 28th in full-season rest differential at -2 and eats the short week here.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.detail: 15th in points per game in 2025, the worst mark of the Mahomes era. 31 points in the opener.

pass.label: Pass offense
pass.detail: 184 passing yards in Week 1. Mahomes threw 2 TDs but the passing game was, by the beat's own description, close to non-existent in the first half.

rush.label: Run offense
rush.detail: Kansas City ran for 220 yards as a team in Week 1, their most since Week 6 of 2020 and the third-most in the Andy Reid era. Kenneth Walker III went 23-173-2 with 14 broken tackles, the most by any back in a game since 2022, and the most rushing yards in a team debut since Michael Turner in 2008.
rush.carryover_note: Kenneth Walker III replaces the entire 2025 backfield behind a line that was already good at run blocking. Last year's team rushing rank describes a different personnel group, so it is given only a quarter of its usual weight.

red_zone.label: Red zone
red_zone.detail: Mahomes scrambled 15 yards for a red zone touchdown on the opening drive.

explosive.label: Explosive plays
explosive.detail: Explosiveness in 2025 came almost entirely from Worthy. In Week 1 it came from Walker on the ground.
explosive.carryover_note: Explosives in 2025 came from Worthy downfield. They now also come from a back who broke 14 tackles in one game.

pass_protect.label: Pass protection
pass_protect.detail: Mahomes was sacked 34 times in 14 games in 2025. The line was porous and heavily penalized. LT Josh Simmons is out again.

pass.label: Pass defense
pass.detail: Allowed 6.9 yards per pass attempt in 2025 (14th) and finished 12th in EPA allowed per pass attempt. Held Bo Nix to 131 yards on 28 attempts in Week 1.
pass.carryover_note: The corner room turned over almost completely. Trent McDuffie and Jaylen Watson both left for the Rams and Bryan Cook departed in free agency. Mansoor Delane was drafted 6th overall, Nohl Williams steps up from 457 rookie snaps, and Alohi Gilman was signed at safety. Last season's coverage rank describes a different secondary.

rush.label: Run defense
rush.detail: The two public measures disagree. Kansas City graded 27th in rush defense DVOA in 2025, but allowed only 4.0 yards per carry to running backs and ranked 7th in explosive run plays allowed to backs. Then they posted the league's highest success rate defending the run in Week 1 at 80%. The DVOA figure looks like volume and game situation, not a front that gets moved.

red_zone.label: Red zone defense
red_zone.detail: 8th in the league at keeping teams out of the end zone inside the 20 in 2025.

third_down.label: 3rd down defense
third_down.detail: Allowed conversions on 44% of third downs in 2025, 29th. The single loudest weakness on the 2025 defense.

pressure.label: Pass rush
pressure.detail: 10th in pressure rate in 2025 on only 35 sacks, but on plays with a dropback probability of 80% or higher they led the entire league at a 47.2% pressure rate. This front feasts when it knows a pass is coming. Generated 45.5% pressure on a 30.3% blitz rate against Denver.

takeaways.label: Takeaways
takeaways.detail: Forced three Nix fumbles and an interception in the opener.

tackling.label: Tackling
tackling.detail: Only New England missed fewer tackles than Kansas City's 75 in 2025.

carryover.note: Offense carries least: new lead back, Mahomes a year off an ACL tear, and a deliberate camp shift back to under-center personnel. Defense is continuous - same coordinator, same core.

neutral_pass_rate.label: Neutral pass rate
neutral_pass_rate.detail: Ran on 51% of first-half snaps against Denver, the 5th-highest run rate of any Mahomes start.

shotgun_rate.label: Shotgun rate
shotgun_rate.detail: Camp priority was returning to an offense built from under center.

def_blitz_rate.label: Blitz rate (defense)
def_blitz_rate.detail: 2nd in the NFL in blitz rate in 2025, top five in each of the last three years under Spagnuolo.

proe.label: Pass rate over expected
proe.detail: 2nd in the NFL at +6.8% in 2025, 20th at -0.9% now. This is the cleanest single number in the file: it strips out score and down-and-distance and still says Kansas City has decided to be a more run-leaning team than the situation calls for.

players.name: Patrick Mahomes
players.note: First full season back from ACL surgery. 184 yards and 2 TDs plus a 15-yard rushing score in the opener; found rhythm in the second half.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.detail: 23-173-2 rushing, 3-18 receiving in his Kansas City debut. 14 broken tackles. The Chiefs finally have a back who can punish the light boxes this offense creates.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.detail: 26.5% target share across his eight full games in 2025 at a 4.9 aDOT. He is the short-area, after-catch engine, not the field-stretcher.
players.src: measured target share and aDOT; routes and TPRR estimated

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.detail: 18.5% target share in 2025. Still the trusted middle-of-field and third-down answer.
players.src: measured target share; aDOT and rates estimated

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.detail: 17% target share at a 12.5 aDOT - the vertical element. Cleared a sprained shoulder and is not on the final report.
players.src: measured target share and aDOT; rates estimated

injuries.note: Starting left tackle. Missed Week 1 as well. The Chiefs protect Mahomes' blind side with a replacement against a coordinator who sells blitz on nearly every down.
Starting strong safety - a real loss for a defense that uses safety rotation to disguise its pressure.

Limited in all three practices. The single most important defender in this matchup: he is the interior rush that makes the blitz work and the anchor against a Colts run game that just went for 98 on 19.
Two full practices then limited Friday. Matters more than usual with a 20.0-aDOT receiver on the other side.

rest.note: Normal week. A short flight to Kansas City and a one-hour gain going west, which is the easy direction. No travel penalty worth pricing.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.detail: 27.4 points per game in 2025, 8th. 2nd in the NFL at 2.67 points per drive.

pass.label: Pass offense
pass.detail: 227.8 passing yards per game in 2025, 9th. Jones was 3rd in yards per attempt (8.1), 4th in completion rate, 6th in passer rating. Then 166 yards on 31 attempts in Baltimore.
pass.carryover_note: Same quarterback, coordinator and route concepts, but Michael Pittman Jr.'s volume has moved to Downs, Warren and Keenan Allen.

rush.label: Run offense
rush.detail: Jonathan Taylor ran for 1,585 yards and 18 touchdowns in 2025. In Week 1 the Colts posted a 50% success rate running the ball, 3rd in the league, against a 36.4% success rate throwing it, 23rd. The run game was the only part that worked.

red_zone.label: Red zone
red_zone.detail: Scored on 71 consecutive red zone possessions from Week 7 of 2024 through Week 10 of 2025 - the longest streak since 1993.

explosive.label: Explosive plays
explosive.detail: 8th in yards per play in 2025 and Alec Pierce led the entire league in target air yards.

ball_security.label: Ball security
ball_security.detail: Jones threw an interception to Roquan Smith and Taylor was stripped by Marlon Humphrey after a catch.

pass_protect.label: Pass protection
pass_protect.detail: 14th in pass block win rate in 2025 with the 5th-most continuous starting five in football. Then Jones took nine QB hits and two sacks against Jesse Minter's pressure package.

scoring.label: Scoring defense
scoring.detail: Allowed 41 points and 506 yards to Baltimore.

pass.label: Pass defense
pass.detail: Allowed 7.1 yards per pass attempt in 2025 (19th) and finished 21st in EPA per pass allowed. In Week 1 they had a 44.4% success rate defending the pass, 30th, and gave up 11.3 yards per attempt to Baltimore.
pass.carryover_note: Sauce Gardner, acquired midseason, played four games; Charvarius Ward was limited to seven by three concussions. Last year's rank was recorded almost entirely without the corner duo they are counting on.

rush.label: Run defense
rush.detail: Allowed 4.0 yards per carry to running backs in 2025, 7th. But the interior line gave up 1.4 yards before contact per attempt, 23rd - they were tackling well, not penetrating. Then 202 rushing yards and three scores to Derrick Henry at 6.0 a pop.

pressure.label: Pass rush
pressure.detail: 23rd in pressure rate in 2025 at 34.2%, with 39 sacks (15th). Laiatu Latu led the team with 8.5 sacks on a 14.7% pressure rate. Anarumo manufactures pressure with design because the front does not win on its own.

takeaways.label: Takeaways
takeaways.detail: Recorded a takeaway in a league-leading 15 games in 2025, 10th in interceptions (14), tied 10th in total takeaways (21).

tackling.label: Tackling
tackling.detail: Indianapolis allowed 10 or more yards on a league-high 29.7% of plays in Week 1 and 7.9 yards per play overall. The team blamed pre-snap communication and moved the green dot to Akeem Davis-Gaither this week.

carryover.note: Both units keep their coordinator and most of their personnel. The offense loses Michael Pittman Jr. and adds Keenan Allen; the defense has moved communication duties to Akeem Davis-Gaither after the Week 1 breakdowns.

neutral_pass_rate.label: Neutral pass rate
neutral_pass_rate.detail: Steichen is run-leaning when neutral. Week 1 pass rate was inflated by a two-score deficit for most of the second half.

play_action.label: Play action rate
play_action.detail: 64% of Colts throws come off play action, the highest rate in the NFL. It is the engine of the offense, it is built from under center, and it is the first thing a two-score deficit takes away.

deep_rate.label: Deep throw rate (20+)
deep_rate.detail: Pierce alone saw 52 of his 84 targets travel 15+ yards downfield in 2025.

def_blitz_rate.label: Blitz rate (defense)
def_blitz_rate.detail: Anarumo blitzed 21.7% in his last Cincinnati season and has run rates north of 40% in single games with Indianapolis. He sells blitz constantly so that a true zero pressure goes unrecognized.

def_man_rate.label: Man coverage rate
def_man_rate.detail: Indianapolis played man coverage on a league-high 46.9% of snaps in Week 1. Anarumo has leaned hard into man in every full game since the Colts acquired Sauce Gardner, up from the 13-16% the previous staff played.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Back from the torn Achilles that ended his 2025. A career-best 100.2 rating and 8.1 yards per attempt over 13 starts in 2025; 19-of-31 for 166 with a pick and nine QB hits in the opener.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.detail: Turned 22 touches into 121 yards and two touchdowns in Week 1. Led all running backs in snap share (88.7%) and backfield touch share (95.7%) - there is no committee here. 323-1585-18 rushing plus 46 catches in 2025.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.detail: Led the NFL in target air yards in 2025. A 20.0 aDOT and 21.3 yards per reception, 2nd in the league. 62% of his 84 targets travelled 15+ yards; he saw two targets all year shorter than five.
players.src: measured aDOT, yards per catch and air yards; share and rates estimated

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.detail: 76-817-4 as a rookie in 2025. In line for a larger share and more red zone work with Michael Pittman Jr. gone.
players.src: measured 2025 receiving line; share and rates estimated

players.name: Josh Downs
players.detail: Playing time dipped in 2025 (3.63 catches per game, a career low) but he is the natural inheritor of the vacated underneath volume.
players.src: measured catches per game; share and rates estimated

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.detail: Signed this offseason to replace Pittman's possession role.

injuries.note: Depth receiver and core special teamer. Did not practice all week. Minimal offensive consequence.
Missed Thursday, full Friday. Was inactive in Week 1, which is how Taylor ended up at an 89% snap share. If he is out again, Taylor is a near-every-down back on a short field in bad weather.

narrative_flags.headline: The run defense signal is genuinely split
narrative_flags.body: Indianapolis finished 2025 allowing 3.87 yards per carry, second-best in football, and 101.9 rushing yards per game, seventh. One week later Derrick Henry went for 144 on 24 carries inside a 202-yard team rushing day. One of those two numbers is lying about this team and the honest answer is that the truth sits between them. The Colts themselves blamed pre-snap communication, not personnel, and moved the green-dot duties to Akeem Davis-Gaither this week.

narrative_flags.headline: Kansas City has decided to be a running team
narrative_flags.body: Reid ran on 51% of first-half snaps in Week 1, the fifth-highest run rate of any Mahomes start in nine years. That is not a game-script artifact - the Chiefs led the whole way. It is a stated camp priority to rebuild the offense from under center around a back who can actually win one-on-one.

narrative_flags.headline: Anarumo will bring pressure. That is the question of the night.
narrative_flags.body: The Colts sell blitz on a high share of snaps and attach man coverage behind five-man pressure with one deep safety. Against most quarterbacks that is how you steal possessions. Against Mahomes, off-schedule, it is historically how you give up the play that decides the game - and Kansas City's answer receiver is Rashee Rice at a 4.9 aDOT, which is the exact throw a blitz surrenders.

narrative_flags.headline: League-high man coverage, against the quarterback who punishes it
narrative_flags.body: Indianapolis played man on 46.9% of snaps in Week 1, the highest rate in football, and Anarumo has stayed in it every full game since trading for Sauce Gardner. Man coverage behind a front that finished 23rd in pressure rate is a specific bet: that the corners win before the quarterback can find the second read. Against Mahomes off schedule, with Rashee Rice working at a 4.9 aDOT underneath, that is the bet with the widest range of outcomes on the field.

narrative_flags.headline: Last year's meeting needed 54 dropbacks. This one should not.
narrative_flags.body: Mahomes finished as the QB11 on 54 dropbacks the last time these teams met. The Chiefs have since gone from 2nd in pass rate over expected to 20th and added a back who broke 14 tackles in his debut. The volume that produced that line is unlikely to be there again.
